question: Which index is the world's first Government-led sub-national measure of SDG progress?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SDG India Index**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **SDG India Index** is the **world's first government-led sub-national measure** of progress toward achieving the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).**
 
• It was **launched by NITI Aayog**, the policy think tank of the Government of India, in **December 2018**.
 
• The SDG India Index aims to measure the progress of Indian states and Union Territories (UTs) towards achieving the **17 SDGs** adopted by the United Nations in 2015.
 
• The index is based on a set of **nationally defined indicators** derived from the 17 SDGs and their associated targets, ensuring alignment with global standards while addressing national priorities.
 
• It helps **benchmark and track the performance** of states and UTs, encouraging them to take ownership of the SDG agenda and foster healthy competition.
